difficultyDesc.easy: A short, gentle trail with minimal elevation. Suitable for all ages, including children and older adults.
difficultyDesc.easy_medium: Slightly longer or a touch steeper than easy, but still very manageable for most people with basic fitness.
difficultyDesc.medium: Either a long hike, a steep one, or a mix of both. A decent level of fitness is required.
difficultyDesc.medium_hard: Not for everyone. Good fitness and some hiking experience are needed — expect real effort.
difficultyDesc.hard: For experienced hikers with strong fitness only. A genuine physical challenge — come prepared.

whatsappCompare.bookmarkletSteps:
One-time setup (on a computer): drag the green button below to your browser's bookmarks bar.
Each time: open web.whatsapp.com → open the hike's group → click the group name at the top → if the members list says "View all", click it → click the bookmark → Copy → paste below.
